content.summary: A weather technician crosses a salt ridge above mirror pools. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult weather technician walking left-to-right along a high white salt ridge with a compact orange pack. Widen without cutting the route and reveal a field of shallow mirror pools below. Hold a very wide result where person, uninterrupted ridge path, pools and mast define one readable scale hierarchy.
